offences.quote: There are no circumstances where students may use GenAI to gain unfair academic advantage. This constitutes academic misconduct (see Academic Manual 9.2.5).
If GenAI is misused in assessment, this is considered under the category of plagiarism or falsification, not contract cheating.

detection.quote: UCL is not investing in GenAI detection software.

In the event that you suspect student work has made inappropriate use of GenAI, you should report it in the same way as any other Academic Misconduct, using the Student Academic Misconduct Report Form (download), to your Exam Board Chair who may initiate an Investigatory Viva.
